name: xstate-actor-observation-contracts
instr:
XState core's inspection channel registers only on a root actor, delivers every kind unfiltered, and aborts when one listener throws. The transition kind is exported, yet no core producer emits it. Unify actor observation into one contract.

Export `inspectionEventTypes`, an array holding each of the six inspection kinds, the transition kind included, exactly once, in any order. Export six guards, `isInspectedActorEvent`, `isInspectedEventEvent`, `isInspectedSnapshotEvent`, `isInspectedActionEvent`, `isInspectedMicrostepEvent` and `isInspectedTransitionEvent`, each returning whether an inspection event is of the matching kind. An inspection filter has optional `types`, `scope` (`'self'`, `'subtree'` or `'system'`) and `actorRefs`, and inspect options add an optional `replay`. Export `normalizeInspectionFilter`, returning a comparable value that is deep-equal for two filters exactly when both accept the same events; `filterAcceptsInspectionType`, taking a filter and a kind and returning a boolean; and `createInspectionPredicate`, returning a per-event predicate that weighs only `types` and `actorRefs`. All of it is reachable from the package root; add no new subpath entrypoint.

An omitted `types` means every kind except the transition kind, which is opt-in only. An empty `types` or `actorRefs` accepts nothing. Order and duplicates are irrelevant, actors match by session id, and allowlists intersect with scope.

Add `inspect` to every actor reference and to the actor system. I
